description:
Because:
- Legacy Node services cannot require @fxa/* libs.

This commit:
- Registers tsconfig-paths in both config modules to map @fxa/* to dist/libs.
- Moves content-server's supported languages to the @fxa/shared/l10n import.
- Adds a @fxa/shared/l10n canary require to profile-server.
- Adds tsconfig-paths to both services' dependencies.
